run_notes: round 30 — drove the v1.0 mission demo script through Chrome live per operator directive 'can you run the demo e2e in the browser chrome that is.' (2) Gateway insists on ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY env even with auth-bypass — placeholder value passes the presence check. Report at docs/skycot/evals/scheduled/2026-05-23/round-30-demo-e2e-chrome/findings.md.
